user.title: Connect to UniFi Play
user.description: Enter your UDM Pro (or UniFi OS Console) IP address or hostname (without https://) and an API key.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the controller. Check the Home Assistant logs for details. Enable debug logging for this integration (Settings → Devices & services → UniFi Play → ⋮ → Enable debug logging) and retry to capture more information.
